resource.name: How [You] Build Product
resource.description: Parody generator for the breathless-reverence-profile genre. Paste a small team's setup, get back the full Series-B-unicorn treatment.

tools.name: how_you_build_generate
tools.description: Generates the parody profile for a team's pasted setup. Returns six sections: pull quote, profile narrative, architecture diagram, origin story, rituals, closing-line lesson.

team_description.description: Free-text description of the team: size, tools, meetings, decision flow.

mode.description: Output format. Profile is the default reverence write-up; twitter-thread reformats as 47 numbered bullets; podcast-cold-open returns a 90-second intro.

mode_alt_output.description: Populated only when mode is twitter-thread or podcast-cold-open; replaces the structured fields with the alt format.

tools.name: how_you_build_save
tools.description: MCP-only (stateful). Saves a team profile for later iteration. Stores profile inputs locally across runs.

_meta.dev.workingfromlenny.phase_note: Web/URL-trick versions don't expose this tool. State requires the MCP App; host's confirmation UI handles the consent surface.

_meta.dev.workingfromlenny.comment: MCP resource spec for #52 How [You] Build Product. Phase 2 .mcpb bundle target. Validated against MCP Apps spec (Jan 2026 release + current draft) on 2026-05-18.

dev.workingfromlenny.path_4.summary: Narration tools in this app return a narration_brief, not the structured prose directly. The outputSchema(s) defined above describe the target rendering structure the host chat model is asked to produce. At runtime each narration tool returns { type: 'narration_brief', audience: 'user', directive, voice_rules, structure: { sections, per_section_template, length_cap }, inputs: <tool-specific>, corpus: { anchor_slug: chunk_text } }. The host chat model then renders the user-facing prose from the brief.
dev.workingfromlenny.path_4.worked_example: bundle/src/tools/pm-pitfalls/narrate.ts and bundle/src/shared/schemas.ts (PitfallNarrateOutput). Sonnet clones this pattern for every narration tool listed below.
dev.workingfromlenny.path_4.supersedes: Earlier 'host sampling + api_key fallback' design. Sampling/createMessage was not exposed by Claude Desktop or Claude Code CLI to user-installed extensions in 2026-05; Path 4 makes the host chat model the renderer, which is the MCP-recommended idiom.

dev.workingfromlenny.open_questions: Confirm structured multi-section output is acceptable in MCP outputSchema, or whether the host renders a single markdown blob better.
Decide whether the twitter-thread and podcast-cold-open modes ship in Phase 2 or get deferred.
dev.workingfromlenny.proposed_answers: Structured multi-section output is acceptable. Hosts can render each section in order, highlight the pull-quote separately, or collapse secondary sections. A single markdown blob is simpler but throws away structure the host cannot recover. Recommend keeping the structured form and offering a mode parameter option (e.g., mode: 'markdown') that flattens all sections to a single string for hosts that prefer it. Do not change the outputSchema; add the flatten path in the narration layer.

Defer both alt modes to Phase 3. The profile output is the core value; twitter-thread and podcast-cold-open add surface area without adding PM-utility that validates the tool concept. Ship the MCP bundle with profile-only, confirm the output works well in the host, then add modes in a follow-on update. The mode enum can stay in the inputSchema now so the contract is established; unsupported modes fall through to the profile default. Note: mode_alt_output was renamed from _mode_alt_output — underscore-prefixed top-level property names are not safe in JSON Schema output.

notes: ui:// scheme is valid; no rigid format is enforced — server-defined slugs after the scheme are acceptable.

No requires-consent / data-retention / fs-write capability exists in either ext-apps appCapabilities or .mcpb manifest. Consent is host-discretion; readOnlyHint: false on stateful tools is the only normative hook.
Underscore-prefixed fields at non-_meta paths have undefined host behavior; project metadata lives under _meta with reverse-DNS keys.
Renamed outputSchema property _mode_alt_output → mode_alt_output: underscore prefix is the _meta convention, not a property-name convention.
